thread:
anna: Quick heads-up 7 open DR followups after the postmortem. Need owners, priority, and a short test plan for each.
kevin: I'll take the routing validation work (audit + scripted flip). Will include latency and error-rate metrics.
maya: I'll own backups + runbook updates. Planning a targeted restore test in staging on Friday afternoon.
lee: I'll run the game-day dry run and coordinate on-call swaps. Suggest Wed 08:00 PT for EU overlap.
kevin: For routing validation: I want to simulate 3 failure modes: full region outage, AZ-level networking blip, and slow peering. Scripted flips for the first two.
anna: Good breakdown. Please include a short checklist for each mode with expected SLOs.
maya: On backups: discovered one project had a shortened retention policy. I'll submit an infra ticket to extend retention for redwood-prod-db to 90 days.
lee: Game-day checklist draft:
- announce window to #incidents 24h prior
- snapshot verification + IAM checks
- routing sim (kevin) + cache population check (post-failover)
- smoke tests + synthetic reads/writes
- restore verification (maya)
- retro + lessons captured
kevin: I'll add a cache-validation script that runs 5m after a route flip and reports hit/miss. Will fire an alert if miss rate > 10% for 5m.
maya: Restore test steps (short):
```
1) confirm latest snapshot: `gcloud snapshots list --filter="redwood-prod-db" --limit=1`
2) restore to dr-test project: `terraform apply -var=dr_test=true`
3) run smoke: `./scripts/smoke.sh dr-test`
4) validate data: `python tools/checksum_samples.py --sample 5`
```
anna: Nice. Add exact service account names to the runbook so game-day volunteers don't get blocked by IAM.
lee: Will do. Also adding a small note to notify EU SRE and DB on-call 30m before start.
kevin: Timeline proposals:
- routing audit + scripts -> kevin -> due 2166120000
- backup retention ticket + runbook updates -> maya -> due 2166055000
- dry-run scheduling + invites -> lee -> due 2165978000
- IAM checklist + service accounts documented -> maya -> due 2165964000
- post-dry-run retro notes -> anna -> due 2166132000
ops-bot: reminder: when tests run, please post artifacts (logs, graphs) to the incident card and tag owners.
anna: Two other asks: 1) add a short post-failover KV-cache sanity check to the runbook; 2) define a visible rollback threshold for each test so everyone knows when to abort.
maya: Added KV-cache sanity item: compare 10 keys and require <5% divergence. Also added rollback threshold section.
kevin: I'll attach the first routing run results once I execute tomorrow's sim. Expect a short summary + perf graph.
lee: I'll confirm Wed 08:00 PT works for EU SREs and post a calendar invite.
anna: Thanks. I'll make the action-tracker card and mark priorities (P0 for routing audit + restore doc). Will ping owners if anything slips. :thumbsup:
